    SELECT 
        d.year,
        d.driver_id,
        d.constructor_id as first_constructor
    FROM drives d
    WHERE d.year BETWEEN 1950 AND 1959
        AND CAST(d.is_first_drive_of_season AS VARCHAR) = '1'
),
final_drives AS (
    SELECT 
        d.year,
        d.driver_id,
        d.constructor_id as final_constructor
    FROM drives d
    WHERE d.year BETWEEN 1950 AND 1959
        AND CAST(d.is_final_drive_of_season AS VARCHAR) = '1'
),
distinct_rounds AS (
    SELECT 
        r.year,
        res.driver_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT r.round) as num_rounds
    FROM results res
    JOIN races r ON res.race_id = r.race_id
    WHERE r.year BETWEEN 1950 AND 1959
    GROUP BY r.year, res.driver_id
),
qualifying_drivers AS (
    SELECT 
        fd.year,
        fd.driver_id,
        fd.first_constructor,
        fnd.final_constructor,
        dr.num_rounds
    FROM first_drives fd
    JOIN final_drives fnd ON fd.year = fnd.year AND fd.driver_id = fnd.driver_id
    JOIN distinct_rounds dr ON fd.year = dr.year AND fd.driver_id = dr.driver_id
    WHERE fd.first_constructor = fnd.final_constructor
        AND dr.num_rounds >= 2
)
